scope.replacesOnly: The 180 existing part-1 semanticId values; no catalog keys or translation/source records are changed.

idGrammar.componentRule: Each dotted component begins with lowercase ASCII a-z and contains only lowercase ASCII a-z, digits, and underscore.

policy.identitySource: Reviewed named source owner, named nested variants, explicit fields/contexts, and curated concrete roles.
policy.positionalIdentity: Array coordinates remain evidence only and are not new-ID components.
policy.maintenance: Treat new IDs as curated stable registry identities. Reordering source arrays must retain these IDs by reviewed source owner and role; changed or ambiguous variants require explicit review.
policy.translationCompatibility: This registry does not convert the current catalog schema to Rust RawEntry, mutate en/ja JSON, rewrite gettext catalogs, or connect the runtime.

records.semanticRole: Low-power distress broadcast with bunker coordinates

You turn on the radio.  You hear a broadcast:
"If anyone can hear, I'm stuck in a bunker and need help.  I'm also transmitting my coordinates.  This message will repeat."
You note down the coordinates.
records.rationale: The explicitly named EOC_BALTHAZAR_RADIO_TRUE runs before the location mission; its balthazar_power < 50 branch broadcasts the plea for help. The array ordinal and then token are replaced by this condition role.
